pages.title: Biomineralisation
pages.text: $(thing)Biomineralisation$()$(br2)Some bacteria grow chains of magnetite crystals and steer by the Earth's field. Kept short of air, they mine iron for you. Unlocks bacterial Magnetite.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Microbiology, Ferromagnetism.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Bacterial Culture, 8 Iron Nugget.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A chain of n magnetite crystals, each of moment m, lines up in a field B against the jostling of heat, kT. Write the share A it lines up by, for a weak field, m·n·B over three kT.
